title: Open inverse image preserves the constructible finite-Tor generators
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, $p\ne\ell$, and an admissible commutative condensed coefficient ring $\Lambda$ as in [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let $X$ be separated and of finite type over $k$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and let $j:U\to X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion. Exact termwise inverse image $D(j^*)$ takes every bounded constant-model constructible finite-Tor complex on $X$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible] to one on $U$. This asserts generator preservation only; it neither assumes nor concludes an exceptional adjunction.

proof.text: Pull back the actual finite stratification using Scheme.Stratification.pullback and the trivializing cover using Cover.pullback₁. The square pullback compositor and upperStarFromPointComp identify the new models with the same finitely presented modules on the point. Transport this along the exact pullback/cohomology isomorphism. Exactness preserves boundedness. Quasi-compactness and separatedness ensure the qcqs branch of constant-model constructibility applies to both X and U.

proof.text: Apply the proved upperStar_preservesFlat theorem to exact module inverse image, then DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_obj to the Tor interval of K. That theorem sends a bounded flat model to its exact termwise image, whose terms remain flat; its support interval is unchanged. This proves finite Tor amplitude without an open projection-formula assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem openPullback_generators
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (_hp : 0 < p) (_hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ)
    (_hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ)
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] :
    ∀ K : ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor Λ X,
      constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ U
          ((upperStar Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj) ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ ((upperStar Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj)
